name: Woodlands Camping Resort
rate_source: woodlandscampingresort.com/rates-reservations.html (2026): overflow W/E sites $60/night, full hook-up $70/night (family of 4)
why: real year-round transient campground with a large seasonal section, but cheapest RV site publishes $60 > $50

name: Take It Easy Campground
rate_source: takeiteasycampground.com/camping-rates.html (2026): full hook-up daily $95/night, weekly $375, monthly $700 + electric; phone reservations only
why: real campground (242 sites, largely weekly/monthly military-contractor stays) but publishes $95 > $50

name: Bumble Bee RV Park and Campground
rate_source: ResNexus live quote (bumblebee.camp booking engine) Wed 2026-10-14, 2 guests: back-in FHU $55, pull-through $60; tent $45
why: real seasonal (Apr 15-Nov 15) transient RV park, 29 FHU sites near Deep Creek Lake, but cheapest RV site publishes $55 > $50 even off-peak

name: Chesapeake Ranch Estate Campground
why: campground at 295 Thunderbird Dr is a listed amenity of the Chesapeake Ranch Estates Property Owners Association (poacre.communitysite.com amenities page, Apr 1-Oct 31); no public booking channel, rate page or listing anywhere; HOA amenity = membership park

name: Seaside View Recreation Park
why: seaside-view.com now serves a lorem-ipsum web-design template (dead/parked); only directory listings remain (visitmaryland, RV Life, allstays), no bookable listing or published rate; last crowd rate $60 (2022) would also fail the $50 gate. Re-open if an operator site reappears.

name: Cherry Hill Park
rate_source: Campendium firsthand 2026-06-16: $94/night (operator site JS-only; aggregator-grade, but ~2x the gate - no reading of the published rate could clear $50)
why: Good-Sam-only row; real 400-site transient park near DC, far over $50

name: Bay Front Mobile Home Court & RV
why: bayfrontmobile-rv.com: mobile home court with monthly RV rentals pitched at the Key Bridge worksite and Trade Point Atlantic; call for monthly rates, no nightly transient product

name: Endeavor Point Campground
why: only a Facebook page (RV Life cg_url 400s), 7 sites, 0 reviews; no bookable listing or published rate

name: Crisfield Elks Lodge #1044
why: Elks lodge RV lot - members and reciprocal guests only (same call as the 2026-09-15 MD Elks skips)

name: Ridge Rider Campground
rate_source: Newbook live quote (bookingsus.newbook.cloud/ridge-rider) Wed 2027-06-16, 2 adults, 23-ft travel trailer: RV sites from $43.26/night
why: Roadville-operated 235-site campground (W/E 30/50A for transients, FHU seasonal); online booking; RV Life 4*/50 reviews

name: Hillcrest River Campground
rate_source: Hipcamp listing (active, instant book): sites from $35/night for 4 guests + $10/day full hookups = $45 (2026)
why: 60-site RV/tent campground off I-68 exit 45 with dump station, showers, 24/7 store; Hipcamp 95% over 174 reviews, staff-verified; RV Life 4.5*/13r. Only web presence besides Hipcamp is pinecliffresort.net (content farm, not cited)
